raw_record.support_text: In a 2-year oral carcinogenicity study (NTP, 1982), B6C3F1 mice were given zearalenone in the diet at 0, 50, and 100 ppm. There was an increased incidence of neoplastic lesions of the liver and of the pituitary, with a statistically significant positive trend in pituitary adenomas in male and female mice, the highest-dose incidence being statistically significant. Because spontaneous pituitary adenomas are rare in male mice and the increases exceeded concurrent and historical controls, they were considered attributable to zearalenone.
raw_record.qualifying_conditions: Dietary administration at 0, 50, and 100 ppm (approximately 7.9/15.8 mg/kg b.w. in males and 9.2/18.5 mg/kg b.w. in females); attribution to zearalenone based on exceedance of concurrent and historical control incidence of pituitary adenomas.
raw_record.extra_details: Estrogen-related effects and myelofibrosis in bone marrow were also seen in female mice (non-neoplastic). The morphologic description of the pituitary tumors was limited. Pituitary tumors are also increased by other estrogenic compounds such as DES, estradiol benzoate, and Enovid.

raw_record.extra_details: Abbreviated MNU. In pms2-/- mice, spontaneous and MNU-induced thymic lymphomas arise through different pathways (Qin et al., 1999).

condition_text: Long latent period of 15-17 years after thorotrast injection; some fatal blood dyscrasia deaths (mostly aplastic anemia) are considered probably misdiagnosed aberrant forms of leukemia.

raw_record.support_text: The summary of hematologically oriented epidemiological studies on thorotrast states that fatal blood diseases, notably leukemia, have been reported as being due to thorotrast. These conditions occur with a long latent period of 15-17 years after thorotrast injection. The paper also notes that the miscellaneous 'blood dyscrasia deaths' are believed to be in the main misdiagnosed and are probably aberrant forms of leukemia.
raw_record.qualifying_conditions: Long latent period of 15-17 years after thorotrast injection; some fatal blood dyscrasia deaths (mostly aplastic anemia) are considered probably misdiagnosed aberrant forms of leukemia.
raw_record.extra_details: Thorotrast is also linked to a group of nonleukemic fatal blood dyscrasias, the majority aplastic anemia; these non-neoplastic outcomes are not treated as a carcinogenic endpoint. Internal-emitter (internal radiation) leukemia latency (15-17 years) contrasted with external radiation leukemia latency (5-7 years).
